story_anchor: Video theo bước hành trình lịch sử hơn bảy thế kỷ của đại học Phật giáo Nalanda, từ cội nguồn khu vườn xoài Pavarika và triều đại Gupta thịnh trị cho đến đỉnh cao học thuật quốc tế thời Huyền Trang và bi kịch ngọn lửa năm 1193. Mạch phim kết nối giữa vẻ uy nghiêm của các công trình gạch nung đỏ cổ kính với chiều sâu tuệ giác Đại thừa, khép lại bằng bài học chiêm nghiệm sâu sắc về quy luật vô thường và di sản tinh thần bất tử soi sáng con đường tỉnh thức hôm nay.

locations.name: nalanda_ancient_complex
locations.description: reconstructed ancient Nalanda Mahavihara, vast symmetrical red-brick monastic architecture, imposing multi-story vihara residential quads, towering central stupa with intricate terracotta carvings, wide brick-paved central avenue, tranquil lotus ponds and lush green trees under serene sky

locations.name: dharma_gunj_library
locations.description: interior of the ancient Dharma Gunj library tower, massive red-brick walls with narrow arched ventilation windows, tall cedarwood timber ceilings, endless rows of dark wooden manuscript racks and carved stone storage chests holding tied palm-leaf texts, soft shafts of natural daylight and floating dust motes

locations.name: ancient_lecture_hall
locations.description: ancient open-air debate courtyard and shaded lecture hall, stepped red-brick terrace seating, surrounding covered colonnade of slender brick pillars, stone podium for speakers, peaceful central tree casting dappled shade, warm ambient daylight

locations.name: nalanda_ruins_today
locations.description: modern archaeological ruins of Nalanda in Bihar, weathered exposed crimson-red brick foundations, towering terraced stupa number 3 rising into a clear blue sky, manicured green lawns, peaceful golden hour sunlight casting long shadows across centuries-old brickwork

key_objects.name: palm_leaf_manuscript
key_objects.description: ancient Indian Tala palm-leaf manuscript bundle, long narrow dried rectangular leaves inscribed with delicate black soot-ink Sanskrit text, threaded through circular holes with silk cord and bound between two dark polished wooden covers with carved floral motifs

key_objects.name: nalanda_bronze_seal
key_objects.description: cast bronze institutional seal of Nalanda, circular medallion featuring a central twelve-spoked Dharmachakra flanked by two kneeling deer, with ancient Brahmi-Sanskrit script engraved below, rich aged green-brown bronze patina

visual_style.film_look: premium cinematic Buddhist documentary, mature semi-realistic 3D, warm amber tones, soft natural atmospheric light, subtle film grain, rich brick and stone textures
visual_style.color_grading: Palette A (warm sacred amber, terracotta red-brick, aged cedarwood brown) for ancient Nalanda monastery scenes; Palette B (soft dawn gold, misty river haze, dew silver) for Ganges valley landscapes; Palette C (dramatic dusk amber, deep shadow charcoal) for historical transition scenes; Palette D (golden hour sunlight, weathered crimson brick, sage green grass) for modern archaeological contemplative ruins.

camera_style.lens: 35mm cinematic baseline for natural documentary perspective; 50mm or 85mm for intimate scholarly gestures and manuscript details; 24mm for expansive architectural vistas
camera_style.movement_notes: slow controlled dolly, restrained lateral tracking, gentle contemplative arcs, and locked-off static compositions; no frantic handheld motion, whip pans, or disorienting camera moves
